title: 레이디스 코드(LADIES' CODE) in Timor-Leste & Bali VLOG #1
description:
레이디스 코드의 동티모르 여행기! #1

슐리 VJ, 슐리 편집, 슐리 자막, 슐리 제작!!
동티모르, 발리의 아름다운 추억을 나누기 위해 슐PD가 직.접. 제작한 동티모르 여행기 그 첫 번째 편을 공개합니다!

Hi guys! It's me Ashley!! :)
As you guys know, we recently went to Timor-Leste for a concert and had a mini vacay in Bali afterwards. I wanted to share as much of our memories and experiences with you guys so I decided to make a vlog. It's my first time ever making one so I know it might not be the best but I hope you guys enjoy it a lot. I put a lot of effort into it & that's why it took so long… T_T I divided it into 3 so it doesn't get too long and draggy… haha :) Let me know what you guys think and I might make more in the future! As always, love you guys so much and thanks for always patiently waiting and loving us. 

Music: Dreams by Dj Quads https://soundcloud.com/aka-dj-quads
